invalidation_reason: The Cloudflare harness removed the mutate container before launching a fresh container without retained storage or remote restore; ABSENT proves expected fresh-container process-local state loss, not a matched durability failure.

The 673.020 ms Cloudflare local acknowledgement and 926.499 ms LayerFS durable acknowledgement use different command bodies, clocks, samplers, persistence media, and retention contracts, so their numeric ranking is not controlling.
